body:
ORIGIN: GitHub issue #154, surfaced building T40 (#138) through the T39 cross-model gate. Self-contained; the issue is background.

PROBLEM: `classifyTrustRootTier` in packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs fires the trust-root tier for a change that touches a PRODUCER package (packages/ticket-prune/, packages/ticket-sync/) or an ENFORCEMENT package (packages/rails-guard/, packages/prosecute/, packages/gate-manifest/, packages/build-gate/) via its path-prefix — EVEN when every changed file in that package is a TEST. T40 added only tests to ticket-prune/ticket-sync and was forced through a full multi-round cross-model review, though a test-only diff cannot change the produced artifact and so cannot cause the producer/consumer CONTRACT mismatch the tier exists to gate. (Hollow tests are caught by P5 prosecution/mutation, not by the cross-model contract gate.)

GOAL: A change whose ONLY files in a package-prefix surface are test files does not trigger the tier on the package-prefix basis. Precision fix — reduce over-triggering (which is fail-safe but costly) without weakening any real trust-root detection.

DELIVERABLES:
1. In packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs, add a test-file predicate: a repo-relative POSIX path is a TEST file iff it contains a `/test/` path segment OR its basename matches `*.test.{mjs,js,cjs}`. (Match the repo's actual test conventions — verify against packages/*/test/ and scripts/test/.)
2. For the PACKAGE-PREFIX surfaces ONLY (enforcement-package prefixes + producer prefixes), a changed file counts toward the tier only if it is NOT a test file. If a package prefix matches solely because of test files, that surface does not fire.
3. LEAVE UNCHANGED (still tier regardless of test/non-test): the EXACT trust-root files (scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs, docs/ci/rails-guard.yml, scripts/test/rails-guard-workflow-hashes.json, .adlc/tickets.json), and the RAILS deny-path surface (a changed file matching any ticket's rails glob still tiers — even a test path that IS a declared rail). Note scripts/test/rails-guard-workflow-hashes.json is a test-PATH exact trust-root file: it must STILL tier, so the exact-file check must run before/independent of the test-file exemption.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- AC1: a diff touching only `packages/ticket-prune/test/**` (or a `*.test.mjs` in a producer/enforcement package) → `isTrustRootTier: false`, `reasons: []`. VERIFY: unit fixture.
- AC2: the same diff PLUS one non-test file in that package → `isTrustRootTier: true` with the package reason. VERIFY: unit fixture.
- AC3: a change to a trust-root EXACT file (including scripts/test/rails-guard-workflow-hashes.json — a test-path file) still tiers. VERIFY: unit fixtures for each exact file, especially the hash fixture.
- AC4: a change to a file matching a ticket's RAILS glob still tiers, even if that path is a test path. VERIFY: unit fixture with a rails deny-path pointing at a test path.
- AC5: no regression to existing packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs or the CLI/gate tests. VERIFY: full `node --test packages/prosecute/test/*.test.mjs`.
- AC6: full root `npm test` exits 0 (except the known publish-over-1.3.0 packaging flake); `adlc rails-guard` passes for this ticket's diff.

DOGFOOD NOTE: this ticket edits packages/prosecute (an enforcement package) with LOGIC (non-test) changes, so it is ITSELF trust-root tier and must clear the cross-model gate it refines. Prosecute accordingly (same-model + cross-model).

RAILS NOTE: rails left [] at authoring (rails have no start-lifecycle — see #159; declaring them now would freeze packages/prosecute/** for unrelated PRs). Declare at P3.

OUT OF SCOPE: editing packages/core/** (frozen); changing the cross-model attestation/gate logic (only the tier CLASSIFIER is in scope); the other tier surfaces' semantics beyond the test-file exemption.
title: Trust-root tier: exempt test-only changes to producer/enforcement packages (fix #154)
